title: Breakout
description:
Experience fast-paced shotgun carnage in this roguelite shooter like no other! Fight through hundreds of procedurally linked combat arenas, upgrade your fighting abilities and destroy an ever increasing number of robotic baddies along the way!

 

Replacing human prison guards with robots might seem like a good financial idea, but now they're in open metallic rebellion, it's time for you to step up. Their elusive creator, Dr Anderson, has entrusted you with a one-of-a-kind prototype: a shotgun capable of healing you when you cause injury to others. Oh, and it shoots grenades too. Tasked with culling the robotic menace (on account of you being a deranged psychotic criminal and all), her problem is now your problem. Get out there and wreck some havoc. I'm sure she can be trusted to hold up her end of the bargain, right?

• Hundreds of procedurally linked combat arenas, bosses and upgrade rooms to fight through, with more on the way with every update. With millions of possible layouts, no two playthroughs will ever be the same

• Face many unique bosses that will test your skills to the maximum

• Upgrade your gear with six distinct abilities and optimise your build from high damage to chaining combos

• Test your skills against over 25 enemy types, with even more added as the game evolves over time 

• An insane shotgun capable of launching grenades, self healing and unlimited ammo; just remember to keep it loaded. No need to conserve shells, get blasting!

• An early 2000s aesthetic that blends simple, colourful grunge in a way only the olden days could

• A wealth of secrets that will test your investigative skills and challenge you to put together the true story of the world around you. They could be hidden anywhere, even right here. Nowhere is off limits!
description_short: Experience fast-paced shotgun carnage in this mini-roguelite boomer shooter like no other! Explore over 100 procedurally linked combat arenas as a metal army hellbent on destruction stand between you and freedom. Are you ready to take them on?
